verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Runway Workflows published as versioned endpoints and an async task API that you poll for results. Both are one-off, on-demand invocations. Nothing documents a scheduler, cron-style triggers or recurring job configuration. Runway Ads' automatic next-round generation is an adjacent ad-optimization behavior, not user-defined recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
